messages:
Maria: Quick sync — finalizing the marketplace compliance bundle for Nimbus SI listing. Need SOC2 PDF, pen test report, completed vendor questionnaire, redacted logs, build manifest, and firmware attestation. Who owns what?
Ben: I can own SOC2 + pen-test coordination. Need partner to confirm scope (external app + APIs?). Suggest a 2–3 week pen window.
Josh: Legal will handle NDAs for sensitive artifacts. We also need an attestation template that says no customer PII is included.
Leila: Eng can produce manifest + sanitized logs. Where should we upload? Prefer presigned S3 with 7d expiry.
Ben: Presign example: `aws s3 presign s3://redwood-partner-artifacts/nimbus/nimbus-compliance-bundle.tar.gz --expires-in 604800`
Maria: I'll own the questionnaire thread and send the prefilled answers back to partner for review.
Josh: Q&A flow: partner submits questionnaire -> security@redwood.com (cc partnerships) -> security triages high-risk answers -> legal reviews flagged items -> partnership confirms go/no-go.
Ben: Pen vendor recs: Cobalt or BishopFox. Scope should include external network, auth flows, and injection/ssrf checks. We require remediation proof (re-test or remediation notes).
Leila: Redaction process: run quick scrub then bundle. Example redaction command: `sed '/user_email/d' logs.json > logs.redacted.json`
Leila: Bundle assemble command: `tar -czf nimbus-compliance-bundle.tar.gz manifest.json logs.redacted.json soc2.pdf pen-report.pdf questionnaire.json firmware-attestation.pdf`
Maria: Timeline: target marketplace publish 2024-12-16. To hit that we need all artifacts in hand by 2024-12-06. Is that feasible for Nimbus?
Ben: I'll reach out to partner tomorrow to lock pen vendor and dates. I'll also add a scope doc template.
Josh: I'll draft the attestation + NDA addendum and post it here when ready.
Leila: One more note: if partner wants to use their KMS key for encrypting the artifact at rest, OK — but presigned link should be read-only and we must not receive keys.
security-bot: Registered pen-test window request: please add ticket in #pen-windows with start/end dates so infra can allow scanning.
Maria: Thanks all — I’ll consolidate TOC + upload instructions and ping Nimbus. Will share final checklist here. :thumbsup:
